title: A logo for Itsy Web
question: Which logo direction should I refine and put on the site? The existing site colors and layout stay in place.

options.label: One thread
options.thesis: A continuous strand becomes a compact i/w mark: a small tool that connects the whole website.
options.viewport: An expressive i/w symbol beside Itsy Web; the symbol stands alone in the browser tab.
options.risk: The strand must stay distinctive rather than becoming a generic infinity loop.

options.label: Itsy, the builder
options.thesis: A tiny, purposeful spider gives Itsy a memorable character without making the product feel like a toy.
options.viewport: A bold little eight-legged silhouette paired with Itsy Web, tested on pale and navy grounds.
options.risk: A mascot is more playful and makes the name’s spider association explicit.

options.label: The slot
options.thesis: A header, page and footer fit together as one compact architectural symbol.
options.viewport: A restrained modular mark and Itsy Web wordmark, with a clear single-color silhouette.
options.risk: The most technical option needs a strong silhouette to avoid looking like a generic layout icon.
